title: Mary Roy Precedent: Christian Daughter Omitted
description: Daughter Mary Chacko excluded from 1996 partition deed
legal_citation: Mary Roy v. State of Kerala (1986 AIR 1011)
remedial_action: Obtain registered release deed from Mary Chacko

title: Ghost Mortgage Detected in EC
description: Doc 3012/2022 shows active mortgage with Federal Bank
legal_citation: Transfer of Property Act Sec 58 / Sec 17 Registration Act
remedial_action: Demand Bank Loan Clearance & Original Title Deeds

title: Extent Inflation: Nemo Dat Quod Non Habet
description: Seller conveyed 11.0 cents but parent deed 890/1996 only granted 10.0 cents

title: Gap in Chain of Title between 450/1988 and 1120/2012
description: Grantees of deed 450/1988 (Family Head) do not match grantors in subsequent deed 1120/2012 (Family Co-sharers). Missing link in ownership chain (possible unrecorded inheritance, death, or third-party conveyance).
legal_citation: Transfer of Property Act, 1882 (Section 7 - Persons competent to transfer)
remedial_action: Obtain missing link document (Legal Heirship Certificate, Partition Deed, or prior Sale Deed) establishing how Family Co-sharers acquired title from Family Head.

title: Extent Deficit: 1120/2012 conveys more land than prior deed
description: Prior deed 450/1988 (1988) conveyed 8.50 Cents, but subsequent deed 1120/2012 (2012) purports to convey 10.00 Cents (+1.50 Cents unbacked by title).
legal_citation: Nemo dat quod non habet (No one can transfer a better title than he has)
remedial_action: Demand seller provide a certified surveyor sketch or rectification deed explaining the 1.50 Cent difference. Do not purchase unbacked extent without Village Officer Field Measurement Book (FMB) verification.

title: Undisclosed Transaction Found in EC: Doc #G-142/2018
description: The SRO Encumbrance Certificate logs a registered entry (Doc #G-142/2018, Nature: Mortgage by Deposit of Title Deeds / Gehan) that was NOT provided in the seller's prior deeds dossier. Possible mortgage, attachment, or partial sale.
remedial_action: Apply for a certified copy of Doc #G-142/2018 from the Sub-Registrar Office immediately. Do not pay any advance until this registered document is inspected and cleared.
